Relative to the qualified candidate-009, the only change is IOHIDFamily rebuilt with the reviewed publication patch da499dd0 (binary 759600a7 -> 820d75b1), plus the KC's inevitable rebinding of IOHIDFamily dependents and its prelink metadata.
